services.name: Chimney sweep
services.blurb: Brushed from the firebox to the cap, with drop cloths down and a vacuum running at the opening.

services.name: Camera inspection
services.blurb: A camera on a rod goes up the flue, and you get the photos of every cracked tile.

services.name: Wood stove sweep and service
services.blurb: Stove pipe, baffle and gaskets cleaned and checked so the stove draws and the glass stays clear.

services.name: Wood stove and insert installs
services.blurb: Stoves and inserts fitted with a full-length stainless liner and the right clearances to walls.

services.name: Stainless chimney liners
services.blurb: A new stainless liner run down an old clay-tile flue that has cracked or shifted.

services.name: Caps and dampers
services.blurb: Caps that keep out rain, birds and sparks, and top-sealing dampers that stop the cold draft.

services.name: Crown and brick repair
services.blurb: Cracked crowns sealed or rebuilt, loose bricks above the roofline repointed before winter.

services.name: Smoky room fixes
services.blurb: Smoke rolling into the room? We find out why: a short flue, a cold flue or the house.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our Rattlesnake bungalow hadn't had a fire in a decade. The camera showed two cracked flue tiles near the top, and Hollis showed me each one on his screen before saying a word about a liner.
reviews.name: Leah M.

reviews.text: They put down a drop cloth that went halfway across the living room and ran the vacuum the whole time. When they left, the white rug in front of the hearth was still white.
reviews.name: Dan P.

reviews.text: Our stove glass was black by noon every day. They cleaned the pipe and the baffle, swapped the door gasket, and told me my larch needed one more summer under the tarp. Clear glass since.
reviews.name: Shawna K.

reviews.text: Swapped our open fireplace for an insert before winter. The liner went all the way down, they explained the clearance to the mantel, and the living room is now the warm room instead of the cold one.
reviews.name: Greg T.

reviews.text: Smoke came into the room every time the wind came down the Clark Fork. They added height to the flue and a cap, and the last two cold snaps the fire has drawn like it should.
reviews.name: Marisol V.

reviews.text: A piece of the crown landed in my gutter. They sent photos from the roof, sealed what could be sealed and rebuilt the rest in a day, all before the first snow.
reviews.name: Walt H.

proof.guarantee: If the hearth isn't as clean as we found it, we come back and clean it again.
